_comment: Default bindings for the Open Surge Engine's controls: the keyboard as the engine's own default map has it (the arrows, Space, Left Ctrl,
Enter, Escape and the Shift keys), and the first pad as the engine's default gamepad layout has it (A, X and Y jump; B cancels; Start and Back;

Open Surge Engine.P1 Up: Up, J1 POV0U, X1 DpadUp, X1 LStickUp
Open Surge Engine.P1 Down: Down, J1 POV0D, X1 DpadDown, X1 LStickDown
Open Surge Engine.P1 Left: Left, J1 POV0L, X1 DpadLeft, X1 LStickLeft
Open Surge Engine.P1 Right: Right, J1 POV0R, X1 DpadRight, X1 LStickRight
Open Surge Engine.P1 Fire 1: Space, J1 B1, J1 B3, J1 B4, X1 A, X1 X, X1 Y
Open Surge Engine.P1 Fire 2: Ctrl, LeftCtrl, J1 B2, X1 B
